en: An illustrated postcard showing an ornate fantasy-style boat on a calm river, with several women dressed in ancient-Egyptian-inspired clothing and headdresses. One woman at the front holds a bouquet of flowers, while others recline or sit under a decorated canopy festooned with hanging fruit. Stylized lotuses and plant motifs adorn the boat, and a distant riverbank with palm trees is visible. The scene is framed like a vintage art-nouveau illustration. At the bottom center appears the printed caption 'SUR LE NIL'; a modern website watermark is also visible.
